evals.prompt: Create a Ruby CLI gem called recipe-box with two commands: `add` (takes a recipe name and --servings, saves to ~/.recipe-box.json) and `list` (prints saved recipes). Write all the files.
evals.expected_output: A gem tree following the conventions: dry-cli + 3 extensions, Launcher, Zeitwerk, VERSION, RuboCop, -n on add only, -i on commands with options.
assertions: gemspec depends on dry-cli and all three extensions
Launcher class takes injected streams and kernel
Help configured to exit 0 without arguments
RuboCop configured with relaxed style (not standardrb)

evals.prompt: Add an interactive mode to the `deploy` command in my dry-cli gem (fixtures/deployer). It has --env, --region and --force.
evals.expected_output: -i/--interactive that prompts per option showing the default, ENTER keeps it, revalidates, STDERR, TTY check, -i with -y rejected.
assertions: current value offered as the prompt default
checks STDIN is a TTY before prompting

evals.prompt: Write Aruba specs for the `export` command in my gem (fixtures/exporter). It prints CSV to STDOUT. Fix anything in the command that would break piping.
evals.expected_output: In-process Aruba against a Launcher, fresh per example; CSV-only STDOUT, messages moved to STDERR.
assertions: Launcher takes argv, stdin, stdout, stderr, kernel
progress message no longer written to STDOUT via ui.info
spec asserts STDOUT is CSV only
spec asserts message goes to STDERR
